clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] 카탈로그에는 데이터셋이 하나 이상 있어야 한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: A catalogue with no dataset cannot serve the discovery function asserted by this profile. The minimum also exercises catalogue-to-dataset traversal in every conforming fixture.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] 카탈로그 언어에는 EU 언어 코드 KOR을 포함해야 한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: The KOR marker gives domestic catalogues a deterministic language-negotiation and indexing baseline. It does not prohibit additional language codes.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] 수집 이력을 추적할 CatalogRecord가 하나 이상 있어야 한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: A CatalogRecord is required to retain harvest and update provenance separately from dataset metadata. This supports repeatable catalogue synchronization.

clauses.normativeStatement:
[en] Each CatalogRecord primary topic must be exactly one of the datasets listed by the same Catalog, and every listed dataset must have a record.
[ko] CatalogRecord의 primary topic 집합은 같은 Catalog의 dcat:dataset 집합과 일치해야 한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Catalogue membership and record topics must agree so harvesters do not create dangling or duplicate dataset entries. The rule preserves the same dataset set across both DCAT navigation paths.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] 데이터셋의 발급기관 범위 안에서 고유한 식별자 하나가 필요하다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: An agency-scoped identifier is the reconciliation key used during repeated harvests. Requiring one stable value prevents title changes from creating duplicate datasets.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] 발행일은 xsd:date 또는 xsd:dateTime이어야 한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Typed publication and modification dates support incremental harvesting and freshness checks. Limiting the value count avoids conflicting update order.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] 수정일은 xsd:date 또는 xsd:dateTime 값 하나여야 한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Typed publication and modification dates support incremental harvesting and freshness checks. Limiting the value count avoids conflicting update order.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] 게시 Dataset은 하나 이상의 dcat:Catalog에 포함돼야 한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Catalogue membership and record topics must agree so harvesters do not create dangling or duplicate dataset entries. The rule preserves the same dataset set across both DCAT navigation paths.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] 게시 Dataset에는 하나 이상의 dcat:CatalogRecord가 있어야 한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Catalogue membership and record topics must agree so harvesters do not create dangling or duplicate dataset entries. The rule preserves the same dataset set across both DCAT navigation paths.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] 공간 공개 수준이 비공개이면 location, bbox, centroid 또는 geometry serialization을 공개 graph에 넣을 수 없다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: The rule prevents precise coordinates from bypassing the declared spatial disclosure level. Publication systems can therefore apply one enforceable boundary before exposing a public graph.

clauses.normativeStatement:
[ko] 공간 공개 수준이 비공개이면 location, bbox, centroid 또는 geometry serialization을 공개 graph에 넣을 수 없다.
[ko] 공간 데이터셋에는 OGC CRS IRI를 GeoDCAT-AP referenceSystem으로 지정해야 한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Explicit, allowlisted CRS and serialization rules make geometry parsing and coordinate transformation deterministic. The restricted RC.1 subset is used because the publication preflight cannot safely validate arbitrary geometry encodings.

clauses.normativeStatement:
[ko] 공간 공개 수준이 비공개이면 location, bbox, centroid 또는 geometry serialization을 공개 graph에 넣을 수 없다.
[ko] RC.1 발행 graph의 공간 공개 수준은 기계 검증 가능한 exact 또는 withheld IRI여야 한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: The rule prevents precise coordinates from bypassing the declared spatial disclosure level. Publication systems can therefore apply one enforceable boundary before exposing a public graph.

clauses.normativeStatement:
[ko] 공간 공개 수준이 비공개이면 location, bbox, centroid 또는 geometry serialization을 공개 graph에 넣을 수 없다.
[ko] 공간 해상도는 0보다 큰 미터 단위 xsd:decimal이어야 한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: A positive metric resolution lets consumers compare spatial fitness without interpreting provider-specific text. Metres are used as the common unit at the catalogue boundary.

clauses.normativeStatement:
[ko] 공간 공개 수준이 비공개이면 location, bbox, centroid 또는 geometry serialization을 공개 graph에 넣을 수 없다.
[ko] 확장 유형과 함께 dcat:Dataset 유형을 명시해야 한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: The condition keeps spatial metadata inside the explicitly supported RC.1 model. This gives catalogue validators and downstream map services the same interpretation of the published graph.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] 공간 공개 수준은 exact 또는 withheld 하나여야 한다. exact에는 location이 필요하고 withheld에는 location·bbox·centroid·geometry를 둘 수 없다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: The rule prevents precise coordinates from bypassing the declared spatial disclosure level. Publication systems can therefore apply one enforceable boundary before exposing a public graph.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] 공간 공개 수준은 exact 또는 withheld 하나여야 한다. exact에는 location이 필요하고 withheld에는 location·bbox·centroid·geometry를 둘 수 없다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: The closed value and cardinality rule makes the disclosure assertion explicit and prevents an unrecognised policy value from bypassing the spatial safety branch.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] 공간 공개 수준은 Dataset, Catalog, DatasetSeries 또는 DataService에만 지정한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: The rule prevents precise coordinates from bypassing the declared spatial disclosure level. Publication systems can therefore apply one enforceable boundary before exposing a public graph.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] GeoSPARQL WKT literal은 선두에 CRS84, EPSG:4326, 3857, 5179 또는 5186 IRI를 명시해야 한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Explicit, allowlisted CRS and serialization rules make geometry parsing and coordinate transformation deterministic. The restricted RC.1 subset is used because the publication preflight cannot safely validate arbitrary geometry encodings.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] GeoSPARQL GML literal의 루트 geometry 요소는 CRS84, EPSG:4326, 3857, 5179 또는 5186 srsName을 명시해야 한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Explicit, allowlisted CRS and serialization rules make geometry parsing and coordinate transformation deterministic. The restricted RC.1 subset is used because the publication preflight cannot safely validate arbitrary geometry encodings.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] bbox와 centroid는 CRS84, EPSG:4326, 3857, 5179 또는 5186을 명시한 WKT 또는 GML literal이어야 한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Explicit, allowlisted CRS and serialization rules make geometry parsing and coordinate transformation deterministic. The restricted RC.1 subset is used because the publication preflight cannot safely validate arbitrary geometry encodings.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] locn:geometry는 geometry node IRI·blank node 또는 CRS84, EPSG:4326, 3857, 5179, 5186을 명시한 WKT·GML literal이어야 한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Explicit, allowlisted CRS and serialization rules make geometry parsing and coordinate transformation deterministic. The restricted RC.1 subset is used because the publication preflight cannot safely validate arbitrary geometry encodings.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] 1.0.0-rc.1 공개 profile은 CRS를 검증할 수 있는 WKT와 GML geometry serialization만 허용한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Explicit, allowlisted CRS and serialization rules make geometry parsing and coordinate transformation deterministic. The restricted RC.1 subset is used because the publication preflight cannot safely validate arbitrary geometry encodings.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] 1.0.0-rc.1 공개 profile은 CRS를 검증할 수 있는 WKT와 GML geometry serialization만 허용한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Explicit, allowlisted CRS and serialization rules make geometry parsing and coordinate transformation deterministic. The restricted RC.1 subset is used because the publication preflight cannot safely validate arbitrary geometry encodings.

clauses.adoptionRationale: Explicit, allowlisted CRS and serialization rules make geometry parsing and coordinate transformation deterministic. The restricted RC.1 subset is used because the publication preflight cannot safely validate arbitrary geometry encodings.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] 1.0.0-rc.1 공개 profile은 CRS를 검증할 수 있는 WKT와 GML geometry serialization만 허용한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Explicit, allowlisted CRS and serialization rules make geometry parsing and coordinate transformation deterministic. The restricted RC.1 subset is used because the publication preflight cannot safely validate arbitrary geometry encodings.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] geometry를 사용하는 모든 Catalog·Dataset·DatasetSeries·DataService에 공간 공개 수준이 있어야 한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: The rule prevents precise coordinates from bypassing the declared spatial disclosure level. Publication systems can therefore apply one enforceable boundary before exposing a public graph.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] geometry serialization을 사용하는 모든 카탈로그 자원에 공간 공개 수준이 있어야 한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: The rule prevents precise coordinates from bypassing the declared spatial disclosure level. Publication systems can therefore apply one enforceable boundary before exposing a public graph.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] Geo 카탈로그에는 Geo subprofile release IRI만 metadata profile marker로 지정해야 한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: The marker selects one validation bundle without guessing from payload content. Deterministic routing prevents a graph from claiming a weaker module than the vocabulary it uses.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] Geo CatalogRecord에는 Geo subprofile release IRI만 metadata profile marker로 지정해야 한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: The marker selects one validation bundle without guessing from payload content. Deterministic routing prevents a graph from claiming a weaker module than the vocabulary it uses.

clauses.normativeStatement: [en] The candidate WKT subset supports explicit-CRS 2D Point, LineString and single-ring Polygon only.
clauses.adoptionRationale: The RC.1 parser and publication preflight implement only this geometry subset. Constraining the advertised type prevents syntactically accepted data from implying unsupported geometry processing.

clauses.normativeStatement: [en] The candidate GML subset supports GML 3.2 Point only.
clauses.adoptionRationale: The RC.1 parser and publication preflight implement only this geometry subset. Constraining the advertised type prevents syntactically accepted data from implying unsupported geometry processing.

clauses.normativeStatement: [en] dcat:bbox must be a closed, single-ring 2D WKT Polygon in the candidate profile.
clauses.adoptionRationale: The RC.1 parser and publication preflight implement only this geometry subset. Constraining the advertised type prevents syntactically accepted data from implying unsupported geometry processing.

clauses.normativeStatement: [en] dcat:centroid must be a 2D WKT Point in the candidate profile.
clauses.adoptionRationale: The RC.1 parser and publication preflight implement only this geometry subset. Constraining the advertised type prevents syntactically accepted data from implying unsupported geometry processing.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] 교통망 데이터셋에는 발급기관 범위를 보존한 망 참조 IRI가 하나 있어야 한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Authority, identifier and edition form the portable key used to join network data across platforms. Requiring each part avoids local database keys that cannot be resolved outside the provider.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] 교통수단은 mobilityDCAT-AP Transport Mode 통제어 IRI를 사용해야 한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: A controlled IRI is required so route, link and mode categories can be joined without provider-specific labels. The value remains comparable across catalogue and connector implementations.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] 확장 유형과 함께 dcat:Dataset 유형을 명시해야 한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: The explicit network dataset type activates the versioned-reference rules instead of relying on property-name inference. This keeps validation routing stable as the ontology evolves.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] networkReference를 사용하는 자원은 molit:NetworkDataset 유형을 명시해야 한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: The explicit network dataset type activates the versioned-reference rules instead of relying on property-name inference. This keeps validation routing stable as the ontology evolves.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] 교통망 식별자와 버전의 발급기관 IRI 하나가 필요하다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Authority, identifier and edition form the portable key used to join network data across platforms. Requiring each part avoids local database keys that cannot be resolved outside the provider.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] 망 요소 유형은 국토교통 망 요소 통제어 IRI여야 한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: A controlled IRI is required so route, link and mode categories can be joined without provider-specific labels. The value remains comparable across catalogue and connector implementations.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] 교통망 식별자 하나가 필요하다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Authority, identifier and edition form the portable key used to join network data across platforms. Requiring each part avoids local database keys that cannot be resolved outside the provider.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] 교통망 버전 하나가 필요하다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Authority, identifier and edition form the portable key used to join network data across platforms. Requiring each part avoids local database keys that cannot be resolved outside the provider.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] NetworkReference는 판 공유와 tombstone 해석이 가능한 IRI여야 한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: A persistent IRI lets multiple datasets share one edition reference and lets withdrawn or superseded editions remain dereferenceable. Blank-node identity cannot provide that lifecycle boundary.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] superseded 판은 종료일과 graph 안의 후속 판 IRI 하나가 필요하다. withdrawn 판은 종료일이 필요하며 candidate·current·withdrawn 판에는 dct:isReplacedBy를 두지 않는다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: A resolvable successor preserves joins across network editions. Active and withdrawn editions prohibit a successor so that the replacement relation has one lifecycle meaning.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] 다른 자원이 NetworkReference를 owl:sameAs 대상으로 선언할 수 없다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Rejecting inverse identity assertions closes the same edition-collapse path even when owl:sameAs is asserted on another resource.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] NetworkReference에는 판 차이를 지우는 owl:sameAs를 사용할 수 없다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Network editions retain distinct checksums and validity intervals. OWL identity would collapse those edition boundaries and make historical joins unsound.

clauses.normativeStatement: [en] Network identifiers must use the profile's portable lexical form.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Authority, identifier and edition form the portable key used to join network data across platforms. Requiring each part avoids local database keys that cannot be resolved outside the provider.

clauses.normativeStatement: [en] State one approved network snapshot lifecycle status.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Lifecycle and validity fields let a connector choose the correct network edition for an observation date. The rule prevents overlapping or reversed periods from being treated as interchangeable snapshots.

clauses.normativeStatement: [en] State one SHA-256 network snapshot checksum as a canonical 64-digit lowercase xsd:hexBinary value.
clauses.adoptionRationale: A SHA-256 digest binds a network reference to the exact snapshot bytes. Consumers can reject silent replacement while retaining the same identifier and edition.

clauses.normativeStatement: [en] State the first date on which this network snapshot is valid.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Lifecycle and validity fields let a connector choose the correct network edition for an observation date. The rule prevents overlapping or reversed periods from being treated as interchangeable snapshots.

clauses.normativeStatement: [en] When known, state the last date on which this network snapshot is valid.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Lifecycle and validity fields let a connector choose the correct network edition for an observation date. The rule prevents overlapping or reversed periods from being treated as interchangeable snapshots.

clauses.normativeStatement: [en] Network versions must use the profile's portable lexical form.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Authority, identifier and edition form the portable key used to join network data across platforms. Requiring each part avoids local database keys that cannot be resolved outside the provider.

clauses.normativeStatement: [en] networkValidFrom must not be later than networkValidUntil when an end date is stated.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Lifecycle and validity fields let a connector choose the correct network edition for an observation date. The rule prevents overlapping or reversed periods from being treated as interchangeable snapshots.

clauses.normativeStatement: [en] State the time window used to compute one aggregate value; do not infer it from temporal resolution.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Aggregation method, window and sampling interval describe different operations and cannot be inferred from one another. Recording them separately prevents consumers from comparing unlike statistics.

clauses.normativeStatement: [en] State how missing observations are represented.
clauses.adoptionRationale: A declared missing-value policy distinguishes absent observations from zero or suppressed values. This is required before a consumer can calculate coverage or aggregates.

clauses.normativeStatement: [en] State exactly one approved aggregation method.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Aggregation method, window and sampling interval describe different operations and cannot be inferred from one another. Recording them separately prevents consumers from comparing unlike statistics.

clauses.normativeStatement: [en] State the kind of feature to which observations apply.
clauses.adoptionRationale: The observation subject and period bound what the series measures. Explicit scope prevents a dataset-level description from being mistaken for record-level observation semantics.

clauses.normativeStatement: [en] Use the approved QUDT unit for the selected observation property.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Property and QUDT unit must be checked together to prevent numerically valid but semantically incomparable observations. The pair is the minimum needed for safe aggregation across providers.

clauses.normativeStatement: [en] Select exactly one approved observation property for a homogeneous observation dataset.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Property and QUDT unit must be checked together to prevent numerically valid but semantically incomparable observations. The pair is the minimum needed for safe aggregation across providers.

clauses.normativeStatement: [en] An observation dataset must state its observation period.
clauses.adoptionRationale: The observation subject and period bound what the series measures. Explicit scope prevents a dataset-level description from being mistaken for record-level observation semantics.

clauses.normativeStatement: [en] Observation interval must be one ISO 8601 xsd:duration value.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Aggregation method, window and sampling interval describe different operations and cannot be inferred from one another. Recording them separately prevents consumers from comparing unlike statistics.

clauses.normativeStatement: [en] An ObservationDataset must also state rdf:type dcat:Dataset.
clauses.adoptionRationale: The dataset type activates the observation constraints and keeps the graph compatible with DCAT discovery. Validator routing must not depend on informal titles or endpoint conventions.

clauses.normativeStatement: [en] Observation property and QUDT unit are not semantically compatible.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Property and QUDT unit must be checked together to prevent numerically valid but semantically incomparable observations. The pair is the minimum needed for safe aggregation across providers.

clauses.normativeStatement: [en] Offering metadata must identify exactly one catalogued dataset.
clauses.adoptionRationale: An offering is useful only when it resolves to one catalogued dataset. The link prevents detached offer records and gives policy negotiation a stable metadata subject.

clauses.normativeStatement: [en] Offering metadata must have one registry-scoped identifier.
clauses.adoptionRationale: A registry-scoped identifier supports reconciliation when offering records are harvested from several providers. It is distinct from the dataset identifier and connector endpoint.

clauses.normativeStatement: [en] Offering metadata must state its last modification date.
clauses.adoptionRationale: The modification date lets catalogues refresh offering metadata without treating every harvest as a new offer. It also gives reviewers a freshness boundary.

clauses.normativeStatement: [en] Use a candidate readiness status. This profile does not assert operational DSP approval.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Readiness is catalogue metadata, not proof of DSP contract negotiation or transfer authorization. The controlled state prevents a planned offering from being presented as operationally approved.

clauses.normativeStatement: [en] The described resource must be a catalogued DCAT dataset.
clauses.adoptionRationale: An offering is useful only when it resolves to one catalogued dataset. The link prevents detached offer records and gives policy negotiation a stable metadata subject.

clauses.normativeStatement:
[en] A quality measurement must be computed on exactly the dataset or datasets that link to it with dqv:hasQualityMeasurement.
[ko] 품질 측정값의 dqv:computedOn 집합은 해당 측정값을 dqv:hasQualityMeasurement로 연결한 데이터셋 집합과 일치해야 한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: The bidirectional dataset link prevents a quality result from being attached to a different dataset than the one measured. This is necessary when measurements are harvested independently.

clauses.normativeStatement:
[en] Every non-lossless mapping must explain the lost, unmapped or unpublished information.
[en] Identify at most one target DQV metric; unmapped and not-published entries have none.
[en] Identify the source quality element.
[en] Preserved or lossy mappings require one target metric; unmapped or not-published entries must not invent one.
[en] State whether the source quality result was preserved, recoverable, lost, unmapped, or withheld.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Transformation loss must remain visible when source quality information is mapped into DQV. A separate disposition and mapping statement prevent omitted fields from being reported as successfully preserved.

clauses.normativeStatement: [en] Identify at most one target DQV metric; unmapped and not-published entries have none.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Transformation loss must remain visible when source quality information is mapped into DQV. A separate disposition and mapping statement prevent omitted fields from being reported as successfully preserved.

clauses.normativeStatement: [en] State whether the source quality result was preserved, recoverable, lost, unmapped, or withheld.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Transformation loss must remain visible when source quality information is mapped into DQV. A separate disposition and mapping statement prevent omitted fields from being reported as successfully preserved.

clauses.normativeStatement: [en] Identify the source quality element.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Transformation loss must remain visible when source quality information is mapped into DQV. A separate disposition and mapping statement prevent omitted fields from being reported as successfully preserved.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] 실제 DQV 측정값에 연결된 매핑은 보존·가역 손실·비가역 손실 중 하나여야 한다. unmapped와 not-published 항목은 측정값 없이 별도 ledger에 기록한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: A published DQV measurement cannot simultaneously assert that no target metric was mapped or published. Unmapped and withheld source elements remain standalone loss-ledger entries.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] 측정값의 dqv:isMeasurementOf와 연결된 매핑의 mappedQualityMetric은 같은 metric이어야 한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: The source-to-DQV mapping and the published measurement must identify the same metric; otherwise the loss ledger cannot explain the value being published.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] qualityResultKind에 따라 dqv:value의 자료형과 단위 사용 여부를 맞춰야 한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Result kind, metric, value datatype and unit are validated as one measurement contract. This prevents a syntactically valid literal from being compared under the wrong metric or scale.

clauses.normativeStatement:

[ko] 범주형 품질 결과 개념은 SKOS Concept IRI 하나로 기록해야 한다.
[ko] qualityResultKind에 따라 dqv:value의 자료형과 단위 사용 여부를 맞춰야 한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: DQV defines dqv:value as a datatype property and GeoDCAT-AP requires a literal value. The separate concept link preserves controlled semantics without violating that range.

clauses.normativeStatement: [en] State one approved quality evaluation method.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Method and evaluation scope are required to reproduce or challenge a quality result. A number without its population, fields, period or procedure is not comparable evidence.

clauses.normativeStatement: [en] State the population, fields, time range or spatial extent evaluated by the measurement.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Method and evaluation scope are required to reproduce or challenge a quality result. A number without its population, fields, period or procedure is not comparable evidence.

clauses.normativeStatement: [en] Link each measurement to one loss-ledger entry; a DQV-native measurement records a lossless self-mapping.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Transformation loss must remain visible when source quality information is mapped into DQV. A separate disposition and mapping statement prevent omitted fields from being reported as successfully preserved.

clauses.normativeStatement: [en] State the quality result kind.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Result kind, metric, value datatype and unit are validated as one measurement contract. This prevents a syntactically valid literal from being compared under the wrong metric or scale.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] 미평가 데이터셋에는 품질 측정값이 없어야 하며, 평가·주의·기준 미달·최신성 만료 상태에는 하나 이상의 DQV 측정값이 있어야 한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: A status without measurement evidence would contradict the quality-status vocabulary. The not-assessed branch also prevents stale measurements from being presented as an unevaluated dataset.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] CatalogRecord 수정일은 xsd:date 또는 xsd:dateTime 값 하나여야 한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Typed publication and modification dates support incremental harvesting and freshness checks. Limiting the value count avoids conflicting update order.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] CatalogRecord는 데이터셋 하나를 foaf:primaryTopic으로 가리켜야 한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Catalogue membership and record topics must agree so harvesters do not create dangling or duplicate dataset entries. The rule preserves the same dataset set across both DCAT navigation paths.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] 파일 배포본에는 SPDX checksum을 권고한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: A checksum lets a consumer verify that a downloaded distribution matches the catalogued file. It remains a recommendation because some service-only distributions do not expose stable bytes.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] 운영 문의를 받을 기관 연락 지점을 권고한다. 승인된 기관 role mailbox를 사용하며 1.0.0-rc.1에서는 전화번호를 게시하지 않는다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: An institutional role mailbox provides an accountable support route without publishing a personal phone number. The recommendation follows the public-metadata privacy boundary.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] 공개 가능한 기관 단위 계보 설명을 권고한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: Dataset-level provenance lets a reviewer trace collection and transformation without exposing internal operational records. It is recommended until a sector-wide provenance minimum is adopted.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] 운영 자격을 검토할 때 사용하는 외부 registry 증거 IRI를 권고한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: A registry evidence IRI makes an operational qualification claim independently reviewable. The link does not itself grant connector access or prove current DSP eligibility.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] DataService에는 공개 가능한 endpointURL이 있어야 한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: A public endpoint URL makes a DataService actionable after discovery. Access authorization and DSP transfer policy are still evaluated outside this metadata check.

clauses.normativeStatement: [ko] DataService가 제공하는 데이터셋을 하나 이상 연결해야 한다.
clauses.adoptionRationale: The service-to-dataset link lets a consumer resolve which catalogued resources an endpoint serves. It prevents an endpoint record from being published without a discoverable subject.
